chunks: And by this chain, from ʿAbd al-ʿAẓīm ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Ḥasanī, from Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl, from Abī Ḥamzah, from Abī Jaʿfar (عليه السلام), who said:
Jibraʾīl (عليه السلام) descended with this verse like this:

Surely those who wronged the Progeny of Muḥammad in their right, Allah will not forgive them, nor will He guide them to a path, except the path of Hell, abiding therein forever; and that is easy for Allah.

Then he said: O people, the Messenger has certainly come to you with the truth from your Lord regarding the wilayah of ʿAlī, so believe; it is better for you. And if you disbelieve in the wilayah of ʿAlī, then surely to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth.

key_terms.آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ: the family/progeny of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الرَّسُولُ: the Messenger who conveys divine truth
key_terms.ظَلَمُوا: they committed ظلم by wronging or denying due rights
key_terms.وَلَايَةِ عَلِيٍّ: the wilayah, authority and divinely appointed guardianship of ʿAlī (عليه السلام)

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith interpret these verses in relation to the wilayah of ʿAlī (عليه السلام) and the rights of Āl Muḥammad?
ai.summary: This report presents the passage as a revelation connected to the rights of Āl Muḥammad and the consequences of wronging them. It further frames the Messenger’s truth as concerning the wilayah of ʿAlī (عليه السلام), calling people to faith in it and warning against disbelief.
